name: Campingplatz Renken
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Renken is located in Kochel am See in the Austrian federal state of Tirol. The surrounding area is characterized by the lake and the surrounding mountains. In the region there are hiking trails and ski areas for different seasons. The site has pitches for motorhomes and tents as well as a sanitary facility with electricity and water supply. Guests can expect a peaceful atmosphere in nature. Activities such as hiking, cycling, and water sports are possible in the immediate surroundings.
